towers.title: Towers & Structures
towers.description: Industrial steel building systems — from multi-story live-fire towers to climbing towers and education centers, forming the backbone of your training base.

burn.title: Live Fire & Burn Training
burn.description: Safe, controlled live-fire and fire-behavior training — interlocking liners, CFBT, and simulation systems for high-intensity realistic drills.

specialized.title: Specialized Scenario Training
specialized.description: Highly specialized scenarios for specific missions — maritime, tactical, hazmat, rope rescue, and psychological training, realistic and repeatable.

accessories.title: Training Equipment & Props
accessories.description: Props, fitness equipment, and competition facilities — completing the loop from physical conditioning to operational training.

fixed-tower.title: Fixed Training Tower (Steel Structure)
fixed-tower.description: Industrial hot-dip galvanized steel, standard and custom — built for multi-story live-fire training.

modular-tower.title: Modular Training Tower
modular-tower.description: Open floor plans without interior load-bearing walls — reconfigure walls, doors, and windows; expand in phases as needs grow.

climbing-tower.title: Police & SWAT Climbing Tower
climbing-tower.description: Climbing tower structures for police, SWAT, and military — integrating climbing, rappelling, and tactical entry into the design.

education-center.title: Fire Safety Education Center
education-center.description: Immersive fire safety education experiences for schools and the public — learning through hands-on engagement.

burn-rooms.title: Burn Room · Interlocking Liner
burn-rooms.description: Calcium silicate interlocking insulation liners — high heat resistance, low maintenance, built for safe realistic live-fire training.

cfbt.title: CFBT Fire Behavior Training
cfbt.description: Fire behavior recognition and control training — helping students understand fire development and tactical decision-making.

fire-simulation.title: Fire Simulation Training Systems
fire-simulation.description: Programmable smoke, heat, and alarm systems that recreate complex fire and evacuation scenarios in a controlled environment.

maritime.title: Maritime Training Facilities
maritime.description: Ship compartments, decks, and confined-space rescue scenarios for realistic maritime and port firefighting training.

tactical.title: Tactical Training Facilities
tactical.description: Reconfigurable tactical scenarios — breaching, CQB, and high-angle rope work for police and SWAT operational training.

hazmat.title: Hazmat Training Facilities
hazmat.description: Leak, plug, and decontamination scenarios for multi-agency hazmat response drills.

rope-rescue.title: Mountain & Rope Rescue Facilities
rope-rescue.description: High-angle, cliff, and confined-space rescue training for mountain and rope rescue disciplines.

psychological.title: Psychological Challenge Course
psychological.description: High-altitude bridges, trust falls, and team-building elements to strengthen coordination and mental resilience.

accessories.title: Training Equipment & Props
accessories.description: Heat and smoke, escape, search, forcible entry, and fitness competition equipment to complete your training base.
